o1:
Enables Hsp70 protein binding activity; DNA-binding transcription factor activity, including RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity.  
Involved in defense response to bacterium; p38 MAPK signaling pathway; determination of adult lifespan; endoplasmic reticulum unfolded protein response; and positive regulation of macromolecule biosynthetic process.  
Acts upstream of or within response to oxidative stress.  
Is located in endoplasmic reticulum; mitochondrion; and nucleus.  
Is expressed in AB; C; germ line; head ganglion; neurons; and intestine.  
Is part of the p38 MAPK signaling pathway.  
Predicted to interact with linc-50.  
Used to study enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli infection.  
Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Alzheimer’s disease; cataract; hepatocellular carcinoma; macular degeneration; and tuberculosis.  
Orthologous to NFE2L1 (NFE2 like bZIP transcription factor 1); NFE2L2 (NFE2 like bZIP transcription factor 2); and NFE2L3 (NFE2 like bZIP transcription factor 3).
